description:
Cast Skittering Invasion by paying {7}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Skittering Invasion.
Resolve the copy of Skittering Invasion, creating five 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
